meta.purpose: Hotel shortlist for a couple (2 adults), 7 nights, private bathroom, queen-or-larger bed.
meta.pricing_method: All prices are the '7 nights' / '1 week, 2 adults' totals quoted by Booking.com for the exact date window shown, for a room with a king or queen bed and an attached (private) bathroom. Booking.com totals INCLUDE the mandatory resort fee and EXCLUDE the 13.38% Nevada room tax, which is stated on every rate as 'Excluded: 13.38% TAX'. A separate 'all-in' figure is computed below and labelled as computed, not quoted.
meta.tax_rate_note: 13.38% is the tax rate Booking.com displays for these Las Vegas properties. It is applied to the pre-tax total to give an indicative all-in figure.
meta.caveat: Hotel rates are live and change daily. Every number here is a real quoted rate captured on 2026-11-25 for the stated dates, not an estimate. Re-check before booking.

hotels.notes: Hosts TWO MICHELIN-listed restaurants: é by José Andrés (1 star) and China Poblano (Bib Gourmand). Its unavailability in the preferred window is a material planning constraint.
